nodes.label: Celery worker (async agent execution)
nodes.rationale: Celery + RabbitMQ for Orchestration: decouples the long-running agent reasoning process from the HTTP request lifecycle, ensuring the API remains responsive.

nodes.label: Citus distributed Postgres cluster
nodes.rationale: Citus for Horizontal Scaling: shards LangGraph agent state by thread_id across a multi-node cluster so the system can handle millions of concurrent conversations.

nodes.label: Langfuse LLM observability suite
nodes.rationale: Langfuse Observability & Clickhouse: provides deep tracing of agent trajectories, token usage analysis, and detailed execution logs for production debugging; uses Redis/Valkey for async event queuing (BullMQ), API key validation, and prompt caching.

nodes.label: LGTM observability stack (Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Prometheus)
nodes.rationale: LGTM Stack for Infrastructure Monitoring: full integration of Loki (logs), Grafana (dashboards), Tempo (tracing), and Prometheus (metrics) across all distributed boundaries.
nodes.norm_label: lgtm observability stack (loki, grafana, tempo, prometheus)

nodes.label: PgBouncer connection pooler
nodes.rationale: Dual PgBouncer Pools (Transaction + Session): optimizes database connectivity by separating short-lived API queries from long-lived agent state connections.

nodes.label: PostgREST automated CRUD API
nodes.rationale: PostgREST for Automated CRUD: exposes the Postgres database directly as a REST API for standard data operations, removing the need for boilerplate FastAPI CRUD endpoints.

nodes.label: Redis Sentinel Cluster (HA pub/sub + caching)
nodes.rationale: Redis Sentinel for High Availability: ensures resilient pub/sub event streaming and caching for distributed components.

nodes.label: Server-Sent Events streaming contract
nodes.rationale: SSE over WebSockets: simpler, more reliable streaming model for server-to-client updates; leverages standard HTTP and provides automatic keep-alive support via FastAPI's EventSourceResponse.
